missions.objective: Make the canonical prediction contract temporally eligible, numerically finite and causally non-misleading at the CeutIA receiver.
missions.scientific_rationale: A predictive forecast must not be rejected merely because causal identification is abstained; prediction and causal inference are distinct epistemic claims. Point-in-time availability and finite intervals are mandatory for valid downstream use.
missions.engineering_rationale: The original consumer omitted receiver-time eligibility and rejected causal abstention; interval NaN could also bypass the lower/upper ordering check.
missions.result: Implemented receiver semantic corrections and adversarial tests; workflow updated to execute the new suite.
missions.remaining_work: GitHub scientific traceability workflow must complete on the corrected branch head.

missions.objective: Emit the CeutIA-owned canonical v1.1 scientific prediction contract from a real SERPIENTE Forecast without inventing method applicability metadata.
missions.scientific_rationale: The producer must carry model/method identity, training window, reference class, OOD state, calibration and provenance explicitly; absent evidence must not be silently converted into a positive applicability claim.
missions.engineering_rationale: The previous CeutIAPredictionEnvelope was structurally compatible only with an older, reduced contract and did not carry scientific applicability metadata.
missions.result: Producer adapter and regression tests implemented; runtime CI run 90 is pending.
missions.remaining_work: CI validation and direct compatibility check against CeutIA canonical hash.

missions.objective: Connect the canonical scientific prediction contract to the actual CeutIA decision endpoint and ensure rejected messages cannot influence governance.
missions.scientific_rationale: A compatibility function or unit test is documentary unless the live governance path consumes it. Scientific compatibility must be executable at the point where prediction can affect a decision.
missions.engineering_rationale: Current CeutIA /decision/evaluate still accepts the legacy SerpientePredictionEnvelope and does not invoke consume_serpiente_prediction; the new canonical contract is therefore not yet the authoritative runtime gate.
validation_requirements: causal abstention accepted as non-causal prediction
legacy envelope cannot bypass canonical gate
missions.result: Gap established by direct source inspection; no code change made yet because endpoint is compacted and requires a full impact-preserving edit.
missions.remaining_work: Integrate canonical consumer without duplicating decision logic or weakening the existing epistemic gate.

missions.objective: Persist the complete canonical prediction record and link it to decisions without treating the forecast as a model release.
missions.scientific_rationale: Prospective evaluation requires reconstructable prediction identity, origin/availability time, model/method metadata, calibration/OOD status and the exact emitted forecast.
missions.engineering_rationale: Current CeutIA persistence stores decision lineage and audit data but has no dedicated prediction record; only prediction_id is currently exposed in the endpoint audit payload.
missions.result: Gap confirmed by persistence source inspection.
missions.remaining_work: Design smallest dedicated prediction table/record and lineage reference.

missions.objective: Reconstruct a prediction exactly as known at decision time and prevent future information from entering replay.
missions.scientific_rationale: Prospective validation is impossible if replay uses revised or later-acquired information that was unavailable at forecast origin.
missions.engineering_rationale: Both repositories have point-in-time mechanisms, but the new canonical cross-repository prediction record has not yet been wired into replay.
missions.result: Mission generated from the persistence/temporal audit.
missions.remaining_work: Implement after durable prediction record exists.

missions.objective: Revalidate the SQLite concurrency and forecast-outcome lineage hardening, then audit PostgreSQL parity.
missions.scientific_rationale: Corrupt or orphaned prediction/outcome state invalidates prospective evaluation.
missions.engineering_rationale: The latest runtime validation run must establish that the shared-connection locking and referential integrity changes are executable under the full runtime workflow.
missions.result: Latest runtime run 34933792088 was still in progress at last inspection; no green claim.
missions.remaining_work: Read final workflow result and continue parity audit.
